title: Revisiting primordial black hole dark matter from axion inflation
summary: We revisit the production of primordial black holes (PBHs) by a U(1) gauge field with a pseudo-scalar coupling to the inflaton. We improve upon the existing literature by working in the homogeneous backreaction regime with numerically computed gauge mode functions, adopting state-of-the-art PBH abundance calculations, and incorporating the uncertainty in the statistics of $δρ$.
